items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 16:1
items.html: (To the question) No coarseness can blemish above the place of its root existence, and therefore, although the foreskin begins immediately after the end of the three lines of ZA, nevertheless he himself does not suffer anything from this. Only the souls of the righteous, which need to receive from the crown of the Yesod of ZA, find that the foreskin, which is above them, rules over them, and they cannot rise as MAN before they remove the foreskin from there. (Part 1, Page 499, s.v. "the foreskin").
